name: io.github.nightmoose/contractgate
title: AISchemaGate and DataContractGate
description: AISchemaGate validates and repairs structured LLM output against a contract, plus DataContractGate.

io.modelcontextprotocol.registry/publish.summary: AISchemaGate validates and repairs structured LLM output against a contract, plus DataContractGate data contracts. Repair uses the violation fields from that check (min, max, pattern, enum, compliance_mode). The contract checks values a JSON Schema or Pydantic validation can leave open. DataContractGate infers and deploys contracts, validates ingest, including ODCS v3.1.0 and v3.2.0, and lists quarantine.

environmentVariables.name: CONTRACTGATE_API_KEY

environmentVariables.name: CONTRACTGATE_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gateway base URL. Defaults to https://api.datacontractgate.com
